comparison.objective: Compare two sleds' friction using gravity-ramp stopping distances, versus adjust a damper until carriage stops meet safety limits.
comparison.physical_skill: Release sleds under controlled conditions, observe stopping distances, compare materials, and select the higher-friction sled; no mechanical setting change or relocking.
comparison.success_condition: Both valid stopping measurements differ by over 30 mm and only the higher-friction sled is placed on the mat.
comparison.reason: This is the closest shared dynamic-measurement primitive, but it tests comparative identification, whereas the candidate tests fine adjustment, locking, and iterative control of one energy absorber under force/travel/rebound constraints.
